title: Topic 1: Introductions & Greetings - Vocabulary
description: Core words for introductions & greetings: hello, hi, goodbye, morning, name, fine. 8 tap exercises with embedded grammar.
canDoStatement: Greet people, introduce yourself, use basic courtesy phrases
introductionText:
hello = a greeting (any time)
hi = informal hello
good morning = greeting before 12:00
goodbye = when you leave
name = what people call you
fine = good / OK
+ phrase bank: My name is... | Nice to meet you | How are you?

grammarBlocks.title: verb TO BE (I am / you are) + subject pronouns (I, you)
grammarBlocks.explanation: verb TO BE (I am / you are) + subject pronouns (I, you)
patterns: I am... / You are... / My name is...

questions.question: You meet a person at 9:00 in the morning. What do you say?
You leave the classroom. What do you say?
Tap the missing word: My ___ is Pedro.
Tap the missing word: A: How are you? B: I am ___, thank you.
Which word is NOT a greeting?
A: Hello! My name is Ana. B: ___

explanations.A1-T01-VOC-Q2: Goodbye = you say it when you leave.
explanations.A1-T01-VOC-Q3: My name is Pedro. = I am Pedro.
explanations.A1-T01-VOC-Q4: I am fine = I am OK / good.
explanations.A1-T01-VOC-Q5: Hello and hi are greetings. Name is not.
explanations.A1-T01-VOC-Q6: When a person says their name, answer: Nice to meet you.
explanations.A1-T01-VOC-Q7: With I, always use AM. I am Maria.
explanations.A1-T01-VOC-Q8: With YOU, always use ARE. You are my teacher.

teacherNotes: Source: tasilla_topic01_introductions.txt, Lesson 1.1. Pass 70%. All exercises tap-to-answer.
